assertions.assertion: Explains request_uri is disabled by default and enabled with Endpoints.EnableJwtRequestUri = true
assertions.rationale: Says disabled by default, enabled via Endpoints.EnableJwtRequestUri = true.

assertions.assertion: Identifies SSRF as the risk and recommends PAR as the safer alternative

Configures AddJwtRequestUriHttpClient with a short timeout and MaxResponseContentBufferSize and a primary handler that validates the IP at connection time (e.g. idunno.Security.Ssrf SsrfSocketsHttpHandlerFactory)
assertions.rationale: AddJwtRequestUriHttpClient with 5s timeout, MaxResponseContentBufferSize and SsrfSocketsHttpHandlerFactory primary handler.

assertions.assertion: Warns that a DelegatingHandler that only validates the URL is insufficient (localhost host names, redirects, DNS rebinding)
assertions.rationale: Explicitly warns DelegatingHandler URL-only checks are insufficient (localhost, redirects, DNS rebinding).

assertions.assertion: Advises not adding retries to that HTTP client and restricting outbound traffic/protecting cloud metadata endpoints
assertions.rationale: Says no retries on the client and restrict egress / protect metadata endpoints (IMDSv2).
